text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up: planning a soft tilt from green->blue tonight during the 00:00-01:00 UTC change window. Aim: 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 25m with 5m holds. Release notes: v2.7.3 (router + policy).
Sara Patel: thanks. which metrics are our kill-switch thresholds? p95/err rate?
Alex Chen: p95 increase >30% OR error rate spike >0.5% sustained for 3m triggers immediate rollback. Also CPU >85% on router-proxy; ops should watch.
Marco Ruiz: @ops-oncall I'll be on watch. I'll run the staged shift script. Config snippet:
```bash
# shift plan
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/shift -d '{"from":"green","to":"blue","steps":[20,50,100],"hold_mins":5}'
```
Lia Gomez: pinned model-version=redwood/llm-v3@v2026-03-18 for blue. Confirmed DB migration is back-compatible.
deploy-bot: deploy started for release v2.7.3 by Alex Chen. build: a1b2c3d. Canary at 5% now. Link: https://ci.internal/build/a1b2c3d
Sara Patel: can we enable request-shadowing for 15m before the first shift? want perf samples.
Alex Chen: good call, enabling shadowing now.
ops-oncall: seeing a ~12% p95 bump in eu-west router at canary 5% (from 210ms -> 235ms). within tolerance.
Marco Ruiz: advancing to 20%.
ops-oncall: error rate steady. CPU 62%.
Alex Chen: advancing to 50% in 10m if no regressions. Reminder: keep rollback playbook open: /playbooks/tilt-rollback.md
Lia Gomez: note: if we rollback, we must also revert model pin to previous tag.
deploy-bot: canary completed. current traffic: 50% blue. next auto-step in 5m unless blocked.
Sara Patel: quick note: update release_notes.md with the runtime flags changed (kv_cache=true). I'll add a line now.
Alex Chen: thanks. If anything cumulative breaches thresholds, plan is to revert to green and throttle external traffic for 10m. ping me if you initiate.
ops-oncall: ack. monitoring slack channel #incidents will mirror alerts.
Marco Ruiz: rolling to 100% now.
ops-oncall: p95 back to baseline. no errors. all good.
Alex Chen: finished. full cutover complete at 01:12 UTC. closing window. :tada:
Sara Patel: will follow-up with short postmortem notes and perf screenshots.
deploy-bot: deploy finished for v2.7.3. status: success. duration: 72m.
